page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is an enhanced general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture. The server is provisioned with 72 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, paired with 288.0 GB of system memory. This maintains a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU without any onboard GPU acceleration.

Network performance is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 33 Gbps. The instance contains no integrated local storage, requiring that persistent data disks and operational filesystems rely entirely on networked cloud block storage volumes. Additionally, the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external configuration for direct internet routing.

With its 1:4 compute-to-memory balance and high-throughput network interface, the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge provides a dense compute resource suitable for multi-threaded applications, distributed enterprise databases, continuous integration pipelines, large-scale web application serving, and backend batch processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is an enhanced general-purpose instance based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, coupled with 288.0 GB of system RAM to provide an even 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The configuration includes no discrete graphics hardware and provides no local physical storage, operating exclusively through network-attached storage volumes. System connectivity is supported by a 33 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating high inter-node traffic across distributed enterprise environments. Because it couples a dense allocation of processing cores with a large memory footprint and substantial networking capacity, this instance fits memory-conscious enterprise applications, clustered relational databases, ETL batch pipelines, and high-concurrency web tiers requiring dedicated x86 compute capacity.
